name: m4-int00e3bb-kperf4
description: PMU profile of the perf integration tip `00e3bbafb8` on the M4 through the kperf helper: cycles and instructions (IPC), L1D load misses (`L1D_CACHE_MISS_LD_NONSPEC`, precise PC) and L2 load misses (`PL2_CACHE_MISS_LD`), scala and scalap corpora. Periods sized from `m4-main-int148-jdk26-scala` (~40G cycles, ~170G instructions per scala op) for ~100k samples per fork.

Compiler built with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); corpora compiled plainly (no `-opt`). Patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), 8G heap, one fork per corpus, about 40 s warmup and 40 s measured (scala: single-shot 4+4 ops, `jdkHome=25.0.4-tem`; scalap: 20+20 × 2 s).
Rerun of `m4-int00e3bb-kperf` without `LD_UNIT_UOP`: the kperf helper takes at most 4 events per session.
